_about: Hand-kept register of work that only people can do. tools/readiness.py counts the entries; nothing here is a typed total. Add an entry when the event really happened, with its date and where the notes are. An empty list means it has not happened.

accessibility_journeys.label: Keyboard only: start, finish the first lesson, answer an exercise (WCAG 2.2: 2.1.1, 2.4.7)
Screen reader: lesson text, board squares and exercise feedback are announced in order
Narrow screen (320 px wide): nothing overlaps, no sideways scrolling (1.4.10)
Text enlarged to 200 percent: lesson, exercise and menus still usable (1.4.4)
Reduced motion setting respected on the map and the board
Audio never plays over changed text (version check)
